problem_type: Existing content projection unexpectedly navigates the canvas
symptom: Golden Path Agent prompt patch hides the shot-table visual column after zoom drops below 80 percent
direct_cause: materializeShots unconditionally requests fit, including rebind-only and idempotent replay; the delayed consumer shrinks the viewport
class_root: Data synchronization and creation-driven reveal share an unconditional navigation side effect
internal_only_reason: Application-owned navigation intent. Existing requestCanvasFit producers and consumer establish the distinction; no new framework API or dependency is introduced.
invariants: Rebinding and replay of existing content do not change viewport or active category
New nodes, groups and tables retain automatic reveal
Node identities, prompts, result attachment, selection, undo and persistence keep their existing owners

door_reduction.why_not: Asset import and image splitting reveal created media; applyCanvasToolCall reveals newly created nodes; production status open-stage is explicit user navigation; materializeShots is the shared projection boundary. These distinct user intents must remain accessible.

generality_proof: All draft edits, project replay and result backfill reach materializeShots. A single creation predicate prevents fit for every non-creating projection, independent of source, model, candidate version or platform.

shared_boundaries.responsibility: Separate creation-driven reveal from existing-content synchronization

same_class_entry_points.evidence: Candidate revision changes update existing nodes without requesting fit
Existing-node replay and result attachment do not request fit when no new group/table/node is created
Fit guarded by created.length > 1; single new node uses focus event; reused nodes do not navigate
Fit only after result.created contains a new node
Fit after creation of at least two image tiles
Explicit user navigation intentionally switches workspace and fits

recurrence.reason: Every revision, result backfill or reopen replay could interrupt an existing reading viewport
same_class_scan: door-map requestCanvasFit: all five production write doors inspected
ShotTableGrid renders prompt in span only at full density; no input-value mismatch
capabilityApplyHandler dispatches materialization to the shared owner; useCanvasFitSignal consumes nonce after 360ms

prevention.invariant: Only newly created canvas content requests automatic fit during materialization
prevention.failure_mode: A non-creating projection issues no navigation request; existing persistence and result writes still proceed
prevention.strategy: Guard the existing fit call with creation intent, excluding rebindable from the navigation predicate

legacy_paths.rationale: Replace unconditional projection-triggered fit; retain the single navigation signal and React Flow consumer

dependency_lifecycle.rationale: The application dispatches an unnecessary navigation command; no upstream runtime behavior or version change is required

migration: No data or persisted schema changes.
residual_risks: Linux CI rerun pending after local verification; local Electron viewport evidence belongs to the parent integration run.

invariant_owner_layer.why: Every projection entry reaches materializeShots; this owner distinguishes creation from existing content synchronization before issuing viewport navigation.
